Package org.apache.beam.sdk.schemas

Class Schema.FieldType

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.sdk.schemas.Schema.FieldType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
Schema
@Immutable public abstract static class Schema.FieldType extends Object implements Serializable
A descriptor of a single field type. This is a recursive descriptor, as nested types are allowed.
